briefdescription.para: Phase 4 Block 1 — Query Module Performance & Reliability Hardening tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers: Q1 — Timeout enforcement (query_engine tg.wait wrapping + tbbWaitWithTimeout) Q2 — Audit logging for federation dispatch / result merge Q3 — Container pre-allocation correctness (aql_runner, adaptive_join, aql_translator) Q4 — Concurrency safety (QueryEngine config setter races)
Test counts: ≥ 20 test cases using GoogleTest.
